theme: Last days at sea before Saturday's landing.
greeting: The calendar's clear and the girls are with Jen, so the water is yours today. The boat comes in Saturday, though, and a handful of bookings want doing from dry land while there's still signal.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat landing logistics still open
needsAttention.detail: In Todoist: the charter ends at Komolac around noon Saturday, and the taxi to Cavtat, an early bag drop at the hotel, and the ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from shore before the boat pulls out of signal.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb converts Sept 18
needsAttention.detail: In Todoist: the Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking charges tomorrow. A quick look confirms the host accepted it rather than letting the request lapse.

needsAttention.title: TPA car and the Sept 20–22 nights
needsAttention.detail: In Todoist: you land TPA Sunday afternoon with no car booked and two nights (Sept 20–21) still open before the Orlando villa — both worth locking before a jet-lagged walk-up on a Sunday.

flagged.title: Revolut set up, first payment out
flagged.detail: Your card is ordered and the account verified, and a $366.63 payment went out today — the trail from getting travel money sorted.

flagged.title: Evite RSVP waiting
flagged.detail: Lauren Misrahi's invitation is still sitting unanswered in the inbox.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail promos — Bloomberg, Hilton, Uniqlo, Press Herald, and the usual.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first pumpkins and winter squash to the markets.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
Disney tickets for the six of you
Confirm Nautilus return transfer to the airport

acts.line: An open calendar and the last full day aboard before Saturday's landing.
Nothing scheduled — the day is yours on the water.
A quiet one; the girls are with Jen through the 21st.
